description: This Java class defines an Android activity called DateWidgets1, which demonstrates the use of date and time picker dialogs. It includes UI setup, event handling for showing dialogs, dialog creation, and updating a TextView with the selected date and time.

classes.name: DateWidgets1
classes.description: Main activity class demonstrating date and time picker dialogs.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and initializes date/time variables.

methods.name: setDialogOnClickListener
methods.description: Attaches click listeners to buttons to trigger dialogs.

methods.name: onCreateDialog
methods.description: Creates and returns the appropriate dialog (DatePicker or TimePicker) based on the ID.

methods.name: onPrepareDialog
methods.description: Prepares the dialog before showing, updating the picker with current date/time values.

methods.name: updateDisplay
methods.description: Updates the TextView to display the selected date and time.

methods.name: pad
methods.description: Utility method to format numbers with leading zeros if necessary.
